annotations.title: Find vision board ideas for a goal

description: Searches the FutureSelf library of 61 vision board goals (careers, health, money, relationships, growth, lifestyle) and returns the closest matches, each with three concrete scenes to picture and a practical tip for building that board. Use when someone asks what to put on a vision board for a goal, a job or a stage of life, e.g. nurses, debt, a marathon or moving abroad.

query.description: The goal, job or life stage, e.g. "nurse", "pay off debt", "van life"
